how_to_use: In Google Flow pick 'Frames to Video' (NOT 'Text to Video'). Upload the file in start_frame as the FIRST frame. Without it Veo invents a new person and room.
Model: Veo 3.1 Quality. Aspect ratio and length as given. Paste only the 'prompt' object as the prompt text.
Leave the end frame empty. If the face still drifts, lower creativity or regenerate; keep the take where frame 1 matches the photo exactly.
Name the downloaded file as in output_file.

prompt.task: Animate this exact photo. The first frame is the photo; keep everything in it identical and only add natural motion and speech.
prompt.subject: The same Indian woman in the photo, about 25: shoulder-length wavy dark hair, small gold hoop earrings, thin gold chain, olive green overshirt open over a white t-shirt, gold bracelet. She sits at a wooden desk behind a black podcast microphone on a boom arm with a round pop filter on the left.
prompt.setting: The same home studio: textured beige concrete wall, metal shelf with plants, books and a framed print, warm table lamp on the left, fairy lights on the far left, a green neon loop-shaped sign (a shape, not letters) on the upper right, closed dark laptop on the desk in the foreground.

action_timeline.action: She looks into the lens, smiles and says the first line, slight nod.
Her right hand opens in a small easy gesture.
Small head tilt, eyebrows lift.
She leans in slightly towards the mic, curious expression, then holds a warm smile.

prompt.camera: Locked-off tripod shot, eye level, exactly the framing of the photo. No zoom, no pan, no cuts.
prompt.lighting: Same as the photo: warm lamp key light from the left, soft green neon rim on the right, catchlights in the eyes.

audio.voice: Warm, upbeat young Indian woman, natural Hinglish (Hindi words in Indian accent), conversational YouTuber pace, close-mic podcast sound.
audio.lip_sync: Exact lip sync to every word.
audio.ambience: Very quiet room tone. No music.

prompt.style: Photorealistic, natural skin texture, real-time motion, 24 fps, cinematic but natural.
prompt.negative: different woman, changed face, changed clothes, white t-shirt only, no microphone, different room, readable text on the neon sign, letters, captions, subtitles, logos, watermark, extra people, camera movement, cuts, warped hands

prompt.task: Animate this exact 3D character render. The first frame is the image; keep the character, outfit, pose and background identical and only add animation and speech.
prompt.subject: The same 3D Pixar-style young Indian man, about 20: fluffy wavy dark brown hair, big brown eyes, thick eyebrows, light stubble, lime green zip hoodie, white t-shirt with the word 'Drishyya' in small dark letters on the chest, black jeans, white sneakers with lime accents. He sits cross-legged on the floor, right hand giving a thumbs up, left hand holding an open silver laptop angled on his knee.
prompt.setting: The same plain off-white studio background with a soft lime-green glow around him, soft floor shadow.

action_timeline.action: He holds the thumbs up, blinks, his smile widens, hair bounces slightly.
He looks into the camera and talks, lowering the thumb to a relaxed open hand.
action_timeline.dialogue: Script do, video main bana deta hoon.

action_timeline.action: He glances at the laptop, taps it once with his right hand, looks back at the camera and winks.

prompt.camera: Static, same framing as the image, full body in frame. No zoom, no cuts.
prompt.lighting: Same soft studio light, gentle rim light, subsurface skin shading.

audio.voice: Cheerful, friendly young Indian male voice, Hinglish, animated-film energy.
audio.ambience: Light soft studio tone, a tiny playful pop on the wink. No music.

prompt.style: High-end Pixar-quality 3D animation, smooth squash-and-stretch, 24 fps.
prompt.negative: different character, younger child, changed hair, changed hoodie colour, missing or misspelled 'Drishyya', extra text, captions, logos, watermark, realistic human, background change, camera move, cuts

prompt.task: Animate this exact photo. Keep every person, outfit, object and the street identical; only add natural motion.
prompt.subject: The woman in the mustard-yellow kurta at the chai stall holding up her phone to pay; the older vendor behind the counter with steel kettles and pots; customers on the left holding small glasses of chai.
prompt.setting: Busy roadside chai stall on an Indian city street at golden hour, the 'चाय' sign above, shops and buildings behind, a motorbike in the background.

action_timeline.action: Steam curls up from the kettles and glasses. The vendor pours chai in a long stream from a kettle into a glass.
The woman holds her phone steady towards the counter, then lowers it and smiles at the vendor. A customer on the left sips chai.
A motorbike rides across the background. Dust glows in the low sun.

prompt.camera: Slow, smooth dolly-in of about 10% towards the woman. No cuts.
prompt.lighting: Same warm golden backlight with sun flare, as in the photo.

audio.ambience: Street ambience, chai pouring, distant traffic. No music, no dialogue.

prompt.negative: new people, changed faces or clothes, different street, text changes, captions, logos, watermark, fast motion, cuts
